name: 바다뱀
subject: A real nonhumanoid aquatic sea serpent, slender long turquoise-scaled body, pale cream belly, golden amber eyes, small swept-back blue fin crest and two cheek fins. NO arms, NO legs, NO human torso. Arrange the entire continuous snake body into a compact elegant S curve with one visible coil, raised alert head and complete tapering tail tip. Clean readable broad scale planes, not thousands of individually textured scales. Snout calm but predatory, a few small fangs, no blood. Whole serpent comfortably within canvas.
